==Description==
'''Marcellus''' was one of the seven [[narrators]] that appeared in [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. He is one of the [[Children of Exo]].

==Appearance==
'''Marcellus''' had light grey skin and dark grey hair. He wore green clothes which had multiple spikes, pipes, and ammo belts around them. On his torso, he wore a grey and pink vest. On his left arm, he wore a glove while on his right, he had a Gatling Gun with three claws instead of a hand.
